purpose: PART_OF packet v2, written before any v2 judgement
supersedes: PART_OF packet v1 for the part_of axis only
why: v1 showed only organization names and descriptions; 14 of 50 items were judged unclear because the names alone do not show an affiliation. That is a packet defect, not evidence about the data.
what_changed: only the evidence shown (Wikidata property P749/P361, both QIDs and labels, the statement item URL, the raw-store response SHA-256 and retrieval time); the same 50 items, no sample change, no other axis changed; the question wording is unchanged except that it names the cited statement and lets general knowledge decide
note_on_graph_evidence_hash: the PART_OF evidence records in the graph carry one aggregate hash of all SPARQL responses; the packets show the per-statement raw response hash instead, found by re-reading the raw store
